theme.name: Saharan Sunset
theme.author: Catto Learning
theme.description: Warm ivory, sand and terracotta skin with Cormorant Garamond headings and Jost text, built from the Saharan Sunset mockups. Every page sits in one paper box on the slanted texture below a full-width header, and Home and course landing pages run full width. The abacus is the home hero, the orb lies behind the footer and decorates course cards without a cover, and the sign-in panel is a lit doorway for signing in and dawn over the dunes for registering.
